description: Epoch AI 'AI Companies' dataset — companies with compute spend, funding rounds, revenue, staff, and usage reports.

body.how_to_read: ai_companies is the entity table; the other files are long-format report tables (compute spend, funding rounds, revenue, staff, usage) joinable by company. Read each CSV header for exact columns. Useful for AI-demand / capex context.

methodology.summary: As-downloaded Epoch AI 'AI Companies' export, cleaned by the epoch_ai ingest, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12. Confidence 0.8 (curated CC BY 4.0 dataset).
